import java.util.*;
class UsesOfHashset{
    //dup objects are not allowed
    //insertion order is not preserved
    //Same type of objects , diff type of objects also allowed
    //Null insertion is allowed once
    
    public static void main(String args[]){
       HashSet<Integer> hashset = new HashSet();   
       hashset.add(10);
       hashset.add(20);
       hashset.add(30);
       hashset.add(10);
     
       
       System.out.println(hashset.contains(10));//search..
       System.out.println(hashset.remove(10));//removing..
       System.out.println(hashset);//order is not preserved
    }
}
